message.content: Li Hua expresses a very positive impression of the Blood and Wine expansion, which is an expansion to The Witcher 3. In one conversation, Li Hua states, "The Blood and Wine storyline is my fave. It's so rich with lore and the twist at the end is just epic!" This indicates that Li Hua particularly enjoys the narrative elements and the unexpected conclusion of the Blood and Wine expansion. Additionally, in another conversation, she highlights the beauty of the new area, Toussaint, saying, "The landscapes in Toussaint are equally beautiful, with all those vineyards and castles. Such a vibrant place!" Li Hua further emphasizes the immersive nature of the quests in this expansion, mentioning, "The quests there feel like you're part of a storybook. I love how they incorporate the surrounding beauty." These comments suggest that Li Hua finds the Blood and Wine expansion to be visually appealing and thematically engaging, with a focus on its narrative and setting.
